description:
# ClearLag For Allay **🧹 Automatic cleanup plugin for dropped items and mobs on AllayMC** [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-0.1.0-green.svg)](https://github.com/Miroshka000/ClearLag/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21+-purple.svg)](https://adoptium.net/) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Allay-orange.svg)](https://github.com/AllayMC/Allay) [![Build](https://github.com/Miroshka000/ClearLag/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Miroshka000/ClearLag/actions)
[![Русский](https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-Русский-red?style=for-the-badge&logo=google-translate&logoColor=white)](README_RU.md)
--- **ClearLag** is a cleanup plugin for **AllayMC** that automatically removes dropped items and mobs on a schedule, sends warnings before cleanup, supports `ru_RU` and `en_US`, and does not remove holograms, NPCs, armor stands, or players. ## ✨ Features - 🕒 Automatic cleanup with configurable interval - ⚡ Manual cleanup with `/clearing` - 🔄 Config reload with `/clearing reload` - 📢 Warning broadcasts before cleanup - 🎛 Separate toggles for dropped items and mobs - 🌍 i18n messages through Allay language JSON files - 🛡 Safe filtering: NPCs, holograms, armor stands, and players are ignored - 📦 Okaeri YAML configuration ## ⌨️ Commands | Command | Permission | Description | |---------|------------|-------------| | `/clearing` | `clearlag.command.use` | Start forced cleanup | | `/clearing reload` | `clearlag.command.reload` | Reload plugin config | Aliases: - `/clearlag` ## 🗑 What Gets Removed - Dropped items on the ground - Living mobs ## 🛡 What Never Gets Removed - Players - NPCs - Armor stands - Holograms built on armor stands ## ⚙️ Configuration ```yaml default-language: ru_RU cleanup: enabled: true interval-seconds: 300 warning-seconds: - 300 - 60 - 10 clear-items: true clear-mobs: true broadcast: warnings: true completion: true permissions: use: "clearlag.command.use" reload: "clearlag.command.reload" ``` | Option | Description | |--------|-------------| | `default-language` | Default fallback language | | `cleanup.enabled` | Enables or disables auto cleanup | | `cleanup.interval-seconds` | Cleanup interval in seconds | | `cleanup.warning-seconds` | Warning points before cleanup | | `cleanup.clear-items` | Removes dropped items | | `cleanup.clear-mobs` | Removes living mobs | | `broadcast.warnings` | Broadcast warning messages | | `broadcast.completion` | Broadcast cleanup result | | `permissions.use` | Permission for manual cleanup | | `permissions.reload` | Permission for config reload | ## 🌐 Localization Languages are stored in: - `src/main/resources/assets/lang/en_US.json` - `src/main/resources/assets/lang/ru_RU.json` Supported keys: - command description - warning messages - timed warning messages - manual cleanup message - cleanup result message - reload message - no-permission message - already-running message ## 🔨 Build ```bash git clone https://github.com/Miroshka000/ClearLag.git cd ClearLag ./gradlew shadowJar ``` Artifact: - `build/libs/*.jar` ## 📋 Requirements - Java 21+ - Allay API `0.26.0-SNAPSHOT`

Created by Miroshka for AllayMC
